title: Code and analysis notes for "Where primordial black holes can come from: how likely formation mechanisms are to produce a given mass and abundance"
description: Code that computes, for ten formation mechanisms of primordial black holes, the probability that each square of the (mass, abundance) plane is populated, with parameter distributions fixed by non-PBH observations (CMB, LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA and NANOGrav gravitational-wave data, BBN). Includes analysis notes (formulas, parameter ranges, statistical procedures, construction of every figure, analytic checks, reproduction steps) and AI_GUIDE.md, a guide written to be read by AI assistants so that the analysis can be followed, extended or repeated for other formation models. The stored samples are deposited in a separate Zenodo record.
